transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a critical legal issue before you approve this release. I received an indemnity notice from the buyer's operations team this morning claiming $900,000 under the Lattice Systems acquisition agreement. This notice is not yet attached to the escrow payment file. The acquisition agreement requires exactly $900,000 to remain in escrow until this claim is resolved. Therefore, the gross release from escrow must be exactly $4,100,000, with $900,000 retained. To be clear, $4,100,000 is the gross amount released from escrow before any tax withholding or other deductions — it is not the net payment to the seller.

I confirmed in a tax memo received today that the seller is a nonresident entity and the release is subject to 10% withholding on the gross amount paid. The memo has not yet been circulated to the closing team. This means the $4,100,000 gross release requires exactly $410,000 to be remitted to the tax authority within two business days, so the net payment to the seller would be $3,690,000. This withholding requirement needs to be reflected in the payment and accounting instructions before approval.
